description.value:
Prerequisites: White Mage 6

The white mage learns to cast a small number of spells without spending magic points. A white mage may select one white magic spell that is at least 2 spell levels lower than his highest spell level he may cast. He may now cast this spell once per day as a spell-like ability without needing to spend MP. The caster level for this spell is equal to the white mage's caster level. This talent may be selected multiple times allowing the white mage to use this talent an additional time per day each time.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Mage Talents)
